geometry.note: OpenStreetMap alone yields at most 'approximate'. The polygon is the whole nuclear-island building as traced, not the reactor vessel; the core lies somewhere inside it.

method: OpenStreetMap way 520344778 (untagged building=yes, ~6718 m2, 16 vertices) kept verbatim. It is identified as the unit's nuclear-island building because the power=generator node 3040238476 (generator:type=EPR, 1660 MW) lies inside it. Core label TS-2 is assigned by matching distance order to the published baselines (52.64 km TS-2, 52.77 km TS-1); the OSM objects carry no unit number.
